description: This file is a Smarty plugin function for rendering phone numbers as clickable 'tel:' links in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It includes license and modification comments, a security check, and defines the function smarty_function_sugar_phone that outputs a tel link for a given phone number value.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_phone
methods.description: Generates a tel: link for a provided phone number value, or triggers an error if 'value' parameter is missing.
